intro: Great progress! Now we put words together into real sentences. You'll practise English word order (Subject + Verb + Object), using 'a' and 'an', and making plurals like books and boxes. Warm-up: try one short sentence about what you like — for example, 'I like coffee.'
teachingNotes: Word order is usually the same as Indonesian (S-V-O), which helps; stress that English almost always needs a subject (no 'Like coffee').
Indonesian has no articles: learners drop 'a/an'. 'an' goes before vowel SOUNDS (an apple, an hour, a university).
Indonesian plurals repeat the word (buku-buku); English adds -s/-es. After numbers, English still needs -s (two books).
Use only simple present with I/you/we/they to avoid third-person -s (that comes in A1).

keyPoints.title: Subject + Verb + Object
keyPoints.explanation: Most English sentences start with who does the action, then the action, then the thing. Always include the subject.

keyPoints.title: a or an
keyPoints.explanation: Use a/an before one countable thing. Use 'an' before a vowel sound (an apple, an egg), 'a' before a consonant sound (a book, a car).

keyPoints.title: Plurals with -s / -es
keyPoints.explanation: Add -s for more than one: book → books. Add -es after s, x, ch, sh: box → boxes, watch → watches. Don't repeat the word like in Indonesian.

guidedPractice.prompt: Put the words in order: coffee / I / like
guidedPractice.hint: Subject first, then verb, then object.

guidedPractice.prompt: a or an? I eat ___ egg every morning.
Make it plural: one box → two ___

independentPractice.prompt: Put the words in order: English / we / study
Make it plural: one cat → three ___

assessment.prompt: Put the words in order: rice / they / eat
assessment.rubric: Correct: They eat rice. Any other order = 0–30.

assessment.prompt: Translate into English: Saya membaca buku.
assessment.rubric: Must have subject I + read + book with an article or plural. Missing article = 70.

assessment.prompt: a or an? She has ___ umbrella.
a or an? My father is ___ driver.
Make it plural: one watch → two ___

id.intro: Kemajuan yang bagus! Sekarang kita susun kata menjadi kalimat sungguhan. Kamu akan berlatih urutan kata bahasa Inggris (Subjek + Kata Kerja + Objek), memakai 'a' dan 'an', dan membuat bentuk jamak seperti books dan boxes. Pemanasan: coba buat satu kalimat pendek tentang sesuatu yang kamu suka — misalnya 'I like coffee.'
